The admitted weather decision already separates current, nearby, approach and forecast evidence, but the ordinary header exposes only its condition. This change carries one exact decision into the existing weather icon name/title and a clipped, accessible `#weather-information` description, including the local settings buckle without replacing its name, warnings, tokens or keyboard action.

The formatter performs no source admission, request, forecasting inference or permission change. It retains model-estimate provenance, target-zone absolute intervals, amount units, null versus zero and qualified probability event/window semantics. Live local observation and arrival adapters remain unavailable. Native positive snow testing also exposed an inherited origin/coupling gap; flakes now use the existing rain cloud deck and column gate.

Implements #36. Merge approval and completed closure are separate, manual gates.

### Validation and retained limits

- 22 new source tests and 245 affected tests pass; four inherited TODOs remain. Canonical generated outputs match the tested runtime; 164 protected interfaces are unchanged.
- Default R0018 timetable styles, the 325×530 card, existing embed/wrapper code, settings behavior, scientific assets and model authority are preserved.
- Nine Firefox day/flash recordings remain unqualified as continuous video. The specification permits crops/clip; inspected current day/night originals, native temporal controls and actual flash low/peak/low evidence support the scoped predicates. No failed video was promoted to PASS, and no initial-Moon readiness or blanket scientific qualification is claimed.
- The resource raw result remains `FAIL_REQUIRES_PRIMARY_DISPOSITION`; the separate accepted finite observed-cost disposition retains 18 exceedances. It makes no weather-exclusive, whole-process/worker, retaining-owner/leak, UI250ms or future-machine guarantee. Instrumented warm decision/reconciliation/forecast/formatter counters stay unchanged; this is not a universal claim about every weather function.
- Original harness failures, clipped Chromium captures, RED cases and packaging corrections remain in custody. Whitespace-only final fixture changes retain the executed bytes and preserve executable tokens/JSON values.
